data.title: AI creates 16 new viruses from scratch, showing promise for drug resistance and drawing warnings about potential for misuse | CNN
data.description: Scientists used an artificial intelligence program to create new viral genomes that are different from any known natural viruses and that targeted specific hosts, according to a new study. The development is a hopeful step toward medical advances, but it also raises concerns around the potential for misuse.
data.author: Deidre McPhillips
